$comment: slim-dashboard runtime configuration.
Copy this file to config.json (it is gitignored) and adjust freely.
Every field is optional - without a config.json the server uses the
built-in GeiliAPI defaults so the dashboard works out of the box.
To support another relay station add an entry under "relays":
type            adapter id. Built-in: "geiliapi". See README for writing your own.
baseURL         relay root URL
tokenEnv        env var(s) holding the monitor/session token (first match wins)
pricingPath     path to the static JS bundle that embeds groupPrices
monitorPath     path to the channel-monitor JSON API
providers       opencode provider id -> { priceGroup, channel, groupName }
priceGroupNames pretty names shown in the group dropdown
overrides       rewrite prices: useOfficial=true shows official price instead
of official x multiplier; multiplier=N recomputes as official x N.
"models" accepts exact ids or "prefix-*" globs.
syntheticGroups virtual groups computed from an existing base group:
actual = officialPrice x multiplier (own id, e.g. "heavy").
tokenSync       browser token harvesting via Chrome CDP (--remote-debugging-port)
providerPrefix  prefix for auto-suggested provider names on deploy (e.g. "geili" ->
geili_openai). Auto-learned from same-host providers when omitted.
providerTemplate used when one-click deploy creates a brand-new provider
